title: Modular Monolith
decision: Use one deployable Modular Monolith with explicit module ownership and typed internal contracts.
rationale: Local-first complexity and current scale do not justify distribution.
consequences: One release and database with enforced boundaries.
revisit_trigger: Measured isolation scaling or independent-release need cannot be met in-process

title: Laravel PHP backend
decision: Use Laravel and PHP for backend and application services.
rationale: Mature web security validation transactions queues and tests fit the product.
consequences: Task 006 selects and locks supported compatible versions.
revisit_trigger: Concrete blocking requirement or unsupported compatibility

title: Vue Inertia TypeScript
decision: Use Vue 3 TypeScript and Inertia in the same deployment unit with Tailwind.
rationale: Dense interactive workspaces without default API/deployment split.
consequences: Strong client typing and one release unit.
revisit_trigger: Measured UX or deployment need proves split necessary

title: PostgreSQL
decision: Use PostgreSQL relational persistence and validated bounded JSONB.
rationale: Integrity transactions search and bounded flexible payloads fit the model.
revisit_trigger: Measured requirements cannot be satisfied after tuning

title: Local first
decision: Core v1 runs locally without public Internet and binds locally by default.
rationale: Protects private educational material and reduces operational dependency.
consequences: External lookup and manual AI are explicit user activities.
revisit_trigger: Approved remote or controlled multi-user deployment requirement

title: Structured blocks
decision: Use registered typed schema-versioned content blocks; Markdown is import export only.
rationale: Supports editing provenance validation and safe rendering.
consequences: Requires registry migrations and block-level diffs.
revisit_trigger: A required content type cannot fit versioned registry rules

title: Immutable publication
decision: Published knowledge lessons baselines and scenario definitions are immutable revisions.
rationale: Protects auditability restoration and deterministic replay.
consequences: Corrections and restoration publish new revisions.
revisit_trigger: Never without an approved migration and audit redesign

title: Simulator first
decision: Institutional Simulator is default Guided Lab; Real-Lab is selective and claim-specific.
rationale: Enables safe repeatable institutional practice while preserving fidelity boundaries.
consequences: All evidence carries origin and simulation must be stateful.
revisit_trigger: Claim-specific fidelity review requires external validation

title: Isolated Scenario Runs
decision: Runs snapshot baselines and never directly mutate persistent Enterprise Baselines.
rationale: Enables reset replay comparison and protects truth.
revisit_trigger: No revisit for v1; any change requires explicit approval

title: Manual AI only
decision: AIInteractionPort supports Manual AI Bridge file exchange and human review only.
rationale: Current governance prohibits automated provider API and local model paths.
consequences: No credentials calls polling metering or provider framework.
revisit_trigger: Only a future explicitly approved roadmap change

title: Postgres search and queue
decision: Use PostgreSQL full-text search and database-backed queue initially.
rationale: Avoids unproven infrastructure while supporting v1 workload.
consequences: Requires ProcessingRun idempotency retry and authorization-aware indexing.
revisit_trigger: Measured relevance latency throughput or availability target fails after tuning

title: Local single owner
decision: v1 has one authenticated local owner; workflow personas and simulated roles are not accounts.
rationale: Bounds access security and delivery while retaining future conceptual extensibility.
consequences: No public registration billing or collaboration.
revisit_trigger: Approved controlled multi-user use case and threat model

title: Source custody provenance
decision: Preserve immutable originals and separate derivatives claims knowledge presentation and learner state.
rationale: Provides truthful authority version and citation boundaries.
consequences: Storage and every publication retain digests and anchors.
revisit_trigger: Never for custody; adapters may change while semantics remain

title: No real execution connectors
decision: v1 has no host device cloud SSH WinRM or production execution connectors.
rationale: Prevents simulation from becoming unsafe operations.
consequences: Commands are display or deterministic simulation inputs only.
revisit_trigger: Separate approved post-v1 connector decision threat model and isolation proof
